name: 158.1 — the verb is a level on a surface of yours
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 158.1: widget:position(x, y) and :size(w, h) on a widget, a window and a button of yours outrank a [name=] rule's position/size through a sheet:install(); :position(nil)/:size(nil) land the rule and sheet:release() the builder's stock place and box; :size(w) under a rule reads {w, art}; a rule's size under a button's art lands the art and the exact-minimum write survives a sweep; a packed widget keeps its packed box under a size rule and after :size(nil); a picture keeps its own box under a size rule, a pin through a sweep, its own again on nil; nil on a widget never positioned changes nothing; a column's child refuses naming its order; the clamp at the root and none inside a surface of yours; a borrowed window untouched.
